title: varco plan JSON
description: The machine-readable plan written by `varco plan --format json`. The envelope is versioned by schema_version; additive changes keep it at 1.

schema_version.description: The version of the document shape. Always 1: an additive change does not bump it.

profile.description: The planner profile that produced the cases. An additive field, so a consumer must accept a document without it.

cases.description: The cases to run, sorted by (host, path, scheme, method, family, id).

unsupported.description: What varco could not plan, with the reason why.

warnings.description: The conditions that qualify the generated cases.

case.description: One request varco can send to both endpoints.

id.description: The first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the canonical case. Stable across runs and independent of generation order.

sni.description: The TLS server name, present for https cases.

method.description: The HTTP method. Only GET, HEAD and OPTIONS are planned (ADR 0003).

headers.description: The request headers varco sends with the case.

note.description: Why the case exists. It states no expected answer.

header.description: One request header of a case.

source.description: Where a case came from: the Ingress identity, the rule and path indexes, and the annotation that triggered it.

rule.description: The rule index inside the Ingress.

path.description: The path index inside the rule.

annotation.description: The annotation that triggered the case, when one did.

finding.description: Something varco cannot plan or test, with the reason why.

code.description: The stable diagnostic code, for example VAR-PLAN-0001.

ingress.description: The Ingress the finding refers to.

annotation.description: The annotation the finding refers to.

path.description: The path the finding refers to.

message.description: What varco could not do, and why.

warning.description: A condition that qualifies the generated cases.

code.description: The stable diagnostic code, for example VAR-PLAN-0006.

ingress.description: The Ingress the warning refers to.
